These are supporting interfaces and aliases, including conjunction aliases;
they are not 13 newly completed numbered source statements. The machine-readable
index is [root/ACCEPTANCE.json](root/ACCEPTANCE.json). Each record is appended under

and focused native evidence.

## Paper 16

The new `NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall` interface installs
one measured, paired, cover-guarded exchange throughout the edge, member and
packed-least programs. The same least program is used by the actual address
scalar and application frontend. The four exact installation statements cover
carrier-coordinate extraction and reconstruction, the original application
report, and selected-measure preservation.

The application-existence packet derives the application's least from the
original type guards and function/argument matching windows. Its class
continuation obtains one common application least from equal function leasts;
neither application least is an input. Function windows are retained explicitly
because a naked packed-least call does not establish a typed carrier.

The integration statement obtains both operand windows from actual accepted
installed-scalar addresses and their original reports at one shared context.
It derives application least existence with only the original syntax/refit
type guards left as explicit type premises. It does not yet establish an
accepted output address for the full application frontend.

Scope and target freezes: `measured-route/` and `application-existence/`.
Their append-only ledgers contain the final native outcomes. Any native-pending
wording in the frozen pre-proof source maps describes the freeze-time state;
the accepted evidence and subsequent ledger entries supersede that status.

## Paper 17

The source check in `p17/CORRESPONDENCE-REVIEW.md` finds no material mismatch
for the arithmetic circuit theorem or the standalone fixed-policy ground
theorem. The printed main theorem requires uniformity in a supplied policy
program, while its current comparator only supplies a decider separately for
each effective policy. Preserve the numbered main theorem as pending.

The checked macro interpreter takes a `Nat.Partrec.Code` as a genuine input and
uses the existing literal policy expansion. It is jointly partially recursive;
when the supplied code realizes the policy selector, it terminates and returns
exactly the existing macro result, including syntactic rejection. A separate
realization target equates the existing effective-policy predicate with the
existence of such a supplied code. These establish the first bounded interfaces
for the uniformity repair. Uniform source compilation and the full uniform
comparison procedure remain follow-up work.

## Remaining boundaries

- The original two type guards remain in paper 16.
- Arbitrary callback calibration to the manuscript and full installed-tuple
  source semantics are not established by the new executable bundle.
- An accepted application output address still needs the original output
  carrier/fixed-point reconstruction.
- Paper 17 still needs a code-indexed source compiler and uniform comparison
  procedure; joint dependence on a supplied near-control parameter should be
  exposed explicitly.
- No numbered promotion is made. Current register remains 156 checked and
  11 pending out of 167.

# Paper 16: measured application least existence

This supporting target serves the application-least gap in
`verification/local-fable-pair-2026-11-22/HANDOFF.md`, especially records
#1421 and #1422. It preserves the combined `P.cover`, `P.W`, `P.V`,
`selectedMeasure P.R`, original `auxiliaryTerm`, and the one measured guarded
paired exchange at function and application level.

`ExactMeasuredApplicationExists` derives `hasLeast` for the application from
the two original type guards and the actual function/argument matching windows.
It composes accepted wrapped auxiliary formation with the arbitrary-exchange
matching-window report (#1338). No function least or application least is an
input.

`ExactMeasuredClassApplicationExists` retains equal successful function leasts
and gives a common successful application least under the genuine object
continuation. The two previously held application least calls are removed.
Both function matching windows are explicit carrier premises. The installed
scalar wrapper can provide these windows from its actual acceptance report.

This is not a claim that a bare packed least call implies typing. The packed
least program checks the context and computes the minimum of the reached
pool; its initial seed membership does not test `W`. The existing domain
theorem characterizes least existence by own-cover occurrence independently
of the exchange and window. Keeping the function carrier premises avoids
silently treating successful selection as typed admissibility.

The type guards and argument window remain premises. This does not close a
numbered paper statement, promote a register item, or prove unrestricted
source application accessibility.

Targets are frozen before proof authoring. Native acceptance, exact theorem
types and standard-axiom output are delegated to the root's serialized gate.

## Installed carrier integration

`ExactInstalledCarrierApplicationExists` discharges both operand matching-window premises from actual acceptance by `install(...).scalar` and their original address reports at one context. The original syntax/refit type guards remain. The conclusion is `hasLeast` at the same installed measured exchange and actual auxiliary term; it does not claim the complete application frontend emits an accepted output address.
# Combined measured route and actual frontend bridge

This packet addresses the Paper 16 measured-exchange installation item in
`verification/local-fable-pair-2026-11-22/HANDOFF.md`. It defines one concrete
route with the original combined syntax, shared measure, cover and thin
matching window, and explicitly installs the measured, paired, cover-guarded
exchange in the physical edge, member computation and packed least. The same
least is supplied to the actual address scalar and original guarded application
frontend. Accepted sources are unchanged.

The substantive bridge is between actual scalar admission of a reported
original address and its physical window plus measured least fixed point.
Both directions are retained. An arbitrary successful least does not itself
provide a window; the actual scalar frontend does. This is the interface needed
to supply function windows for the application-existence continuation.

`ExactInstalledApplicationReport` retains the existing two-way internal
application report at these installed programs. `ExactInstalledMeasurePreserving`
discharges preservation for the actual installed edge; it does not posit the
false preservation premise for the unrestricted directed exchange.

All parameters are selected before the arbitrary object-calculus body, context,
and free terms. The target uses the original physical address report, original
program graphs and measured least encoding. Existing generic suppliers apply
without a `directedX` substitution for the measured exchange.

This is an internal executable-program installation and wrapper result. It does
not establish all-input calibration of arbitrary supplied base/callback programs
to the manuscript's raw source exchange, full `InstalledTupleAt` source
calibration, discharge of the two application type guards, or a numbered-paper
claim. No register promotion is justified by this packet alone.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Serialized native gate for the local three-party continuation.
# Usage: gate.sh core|mathlib MODULE [MODULE...]
#   core    -> python3 scripts/check.py --core-profile ...            (paper16 / Init-Lean-Std closures)
#   mathlib -> python3 scripts/check.py --memory-mib 2048 --rss-mib 1536 --min-free-mib 2048 ...
# scripts/check.py, its caps, locks and pins are unchanged. This wrapper only
# waits politely when the single compiler lock is busy (exit 75) or the memory
# gate is closed (exit 76), and raises a flag so the background cache warmer yields.
set -u
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"; root="$(cd "$here/../.." && pwd)"
profile="${1:?profile}"; shift
case "$profile" in
  core) flags=(--core-profile) ;;
  mathlib) flags=(--memory-mib 2048 --rss-mib 1536 --min-free-mib 2048) ;;
  *) echo "profile must be core or mathlib" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
flag="$here/logs/gate-waiting.$$"; : > "$flag"; trap 'rm -f "$flag"' EXIT
cd "$root" || exit 2
deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + ${GATE_WAIT_SECONDS:-1500} ))
while :; do
  touch "$flag"
  python3 scripts/check.py "${flags[@]}" "$@"; rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 75 ] && [ "$rc" -ne 76 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi
  if [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$deadline" ]; then echo "GATE_WAIT_TIMEOUT rc=$rc" >&2; exit "$rc"; fi
  sleep $(( rc == 76 ? 20 : 3 ))
done

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceIntegrationTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedDomainTargets (hasLeast)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveOpenTargets (addressReport)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall (install)

/-- Two actual accepted scalar addresses, with their original common-context
field reports, supply the carrier windows required for application formation.
The measured least of their application therefore exists. No function window,
argument window, least call or measure-preservation law is an extra premise.
The syntax and refitted type guards remain explicit. -/
def ExactInstalledCarrierApplicationExists : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (hasLeast Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg)))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceIntegrationTargets
module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceIntegrationTargets
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstallProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceIntegrationProof
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceProof (exact_MeasuredApplicationExists)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstallProof (exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceIntegrationTargets

theorem exact_InstalledCarrierApplicationExists : ExactInstalledCarrierApplicationExists := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg Q
    syn ty functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted argumentAccepted
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other
    body α Γ qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn functionReport functionAccepted
  obtain ⟨a⟩ := exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other
    body α Γ qa ctx dom arg argumentReport argumentAccepted
  have function := Derivation.conjunctionLeft
    (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight f))
  have argument := Derivation.conjunctionLeft
    (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight a))
  exact exact_MeasuredApplicationExists V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod fn arg
    syn ty ⟨function⟩ ⟨argument⟩

#print axioms exact_InstalledCarrierApplicationExists
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceIntegrationProof

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontendDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationOutputCoreTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowAddressApplication

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontendTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators
open ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalFiniteBlocks (block)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (eqn)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram List.Vector
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitter (addressGood arrowGood)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitterObjectTargets (addressReports arrowReports addressTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathAdvanceTargets (ActualLeastCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (z suc unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationOutputCoreTargets (outputReport)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontend (applicationGuard)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings scalar)

/-- Actual scalar calibration on the whole raw address input, not an
assertion about the underlying class coordinate and not object reflection. -/
def ActualScalarCalibration (s : Settings) (i : Program 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, evaluate i (q ::ᵥ nil) = (scalar s q).toNat

/-- Original all-raw canonical application graph at the actual guarded
physical program, with the same original scalar i and actual packed
least calibration. No ValidWindow or input-success premise. -/
def ExactAllInputGuardedApplication : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (i : Program 1) (least : Program 3),
    ActualScalarCalibration s i → ActualLeastCalibration s least →
    ∀ f u y, evaluate (applicationGuard i least) (f ::ᵥ u ::ᵥ y ::ᵥ nil) =
      (NumberedWindowAddressApplication.graph s f u y).toNat

/-- Real selected unary graphs plus the literal shared context/domain
equations. Keep the raw source result separate from its arrow components;
the argument's result is exactly the domain, not another arrow. -/
def parsedApplicationInputs {α : Type} (f u ctx result dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary addressGood (suc z) f ⊓
    (unary addressGood (suc z) u ⊓
      (unary arrowGood (suc z) f ⊓
        (addressReports f ctx result fn ⊓
          (addressReports u ctx dom arg ⊓
            (arrowReports f dom cod ⊓
              (eqn f (addressTerm ctx result fn) ⊓
                (eqn result (rawCons dom cod) ⊓ eqn u (addressTerm ctx dom arg))))))))

/-- Original function, argument and result remain fixed through this
ordered six-variable block. The nested existing output report has its
own single genuine least witness, shared by the actual least graph
and the final equation for the original output address. -/
def applicationRow {α : Type} (least : Program 3) (f u y : OTerm α) : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 6) :=
  let j : α → α ⊕ Fin 6 := Sum.inl
  let ctx : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 0)
  let result : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 1)
  let dom : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 2)
  let cod : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 3)
  let fn : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 4)
  let arg : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 5)
  parsedApplicationInputs (f.relabel j) (u.relabel j) ctx result dom cod fn arg ⊓
    outputReport least ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg) (y.relabel j)

/-- The genuine scalar graphs remain at the two whole original inputs.
The block asserts no scalar admission or other carrier at y. -/
def applicationReport {α : Type} (i : Program 1) (least : Program 3) (f u y : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary i (suc z) f ⊓ (unary i (suc z) u ⊓ block (applicationRow least f u y))

/-- Genuine internal graph equivalence in the same arbitrary body and
ordinary context, with no arithmetic equality reflection or callback
semantics assumed. -/
def ExactOpenGuardedApplication : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (i : Program 1) (least : Program 3)
    (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (f u y : OTerm α),
    let accepted := programGraph (applicationGuard i least) (suc z) ![f,u,y]

open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators

open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitter (addressGood arrowGood)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitterObjectTargets (addressReports arrowReports addressTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathAdvanceTargets (ActualLeastCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (z suc unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationOutputCoreTargets (outputReport)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontend (applicationGuard)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings scalar)

/-- Actual scalar calibration on the whole raw address input, not an
assertion about the underlying class coordinate and not object reflection. -/
def ActualScalarCalibration (s : Settings) (i : Program 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, evaluate i (q ::ᵥ nil) = (scalar s q).toNat

/-- Original all-raw canonical application graph at the actual guarded
physical program, with the same original scalar i and actual packed
least calibration. No ValidWindow or input-success premise. -/
def ExactAllInputGuardedApplication : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (i : Program 1) (least : Program 3),
    ActualScalarCalibration s i → ActualLeastCalibration s least →
    ∀ f u y, evaluate (applicationGuard i least) (f ::ᵥ u ::ᵥ y ::ᵥ nil) =
      (NumberedWindowAddressApplication.graph s f u y).toNat

/-- Real selected unary graphs plus the literal shared context/domain
equations. Keep the raw source result separate from its arrow components;
the argument's result is exactly the domain, not another arrow. -/
def parsedApplicationInputs {α : Type} (f u ctx result dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary addressGood (suc z) f ⊓
    (unary addressGood (suc z) u ⊓
      (unary arrowGood (suc z) f ⊓
        (addressReports f ctx result fn ⊓
          (addressReports u ctx dom arg ⊓
            (arrowReports f dom cod ⊓
              (eqn f (addressTerm ctx result fn) ⊓
                (eqn result (rawCons dom cod) ⊓ eqn u (addressTerm ctx dom arg))))))))

/-- Original function, argument and result remain fixed through this
ordered six-variable block. The nested existing output report has its
own single genuine least witness, shared by the actual least graph
and the final equation for the original output address. -/
def applicationRow {α : Type} (least : Program 3) (f u y : OTerm α) : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 6) :=
  let j : α → α ⊕ Fin 6 := Sum.inl
  let ctx : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 0)
  let result : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 1)
  let dom : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 2)
  let cod : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 3)
  let fn : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 4)
  let arg : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 6) := .var (.inr 5)
  parsedApplicationInputs (f.relabel j) (u.relabel j) ctx result dom cod fn arg ⊓
    outputReport least ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg) (y.relabel j)

/-- The genuine scalar graphs remain at the two whole original inputs.
The block asserts no scalar admission or other carrier at y. -/
def applicationReport {α : Type} (i : Program 1) (least : Program 3) (f u y : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary i (suc z) f ⊓ (unary i (suc z) u ⊓ block (applicationRow least f u y))

ordinary context, with no arithmetic equality reflection or callback
semantics assumed. -/
def ExactOpenGuardedApplication : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (i : Program 1) (least : Program 3)
    (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (f u y : OTerm α),
    let accepted := programGraph (applicationGuard i least) (suc z) ![f,u,y]
    let reported := applicationReport i least f u y
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((accepted.imp reported) ⊓ (reported.imp accepted)))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontendTargets

open FirstOrder Language

/-- Actual optional output computation in the original canonical
application after its real source guards, on the selected raw values.
Only the output leg is specified here; no active input guard is assumed
or decided by this core on the arbitrary input tape. -/
def originalOutput (s : Settings) (ctx dom cod fn arg : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (packedLeast s ctx cod (packNode 6 [dom,cod,fn,arg])).map
    (fun k => packNode 3 [ctx,cod,k])

/-- All-input original equality, including zero, undecodable packed
context, absent least, and malformed seed data. Nothing identifies an
unrelated old application program with this AST. -/
def ExactAllInputApplicationOutputCore : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (least : Program 3), ActualLeastCalibration s least →
    ∀ ctx dom cod fn arg y,
      evaluate (outputCore least) (ctx ::ᵥ dom ::ᵥ cod ::ᵥ fn ::ᵥ arg ::ᵥ y ::ᵥ nil) =
        ((originalOutput s ctx dom cod fn arg == some y).toNat)

/-- The single successful class code is a genuine object-language
existential. The same witness occurs in the actual optional least
graph and the original output-address equation. -/
def outputReport {α : Type} (least : Program 3) (ctx cod raw y : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  let j : α → α ⊕ Fin 1 := Sum.inl

same ID1 body and ordinary context. No numerical premise and no input or
output carrier assertion. The full physical application front end is
a separate obligation. -/

  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (least : Program 3) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod fn arg y : OTerm α),
    let unitGraph := programGraph (outputCore least) (suc z) ![ctx,dom,cod,fn,arg,y]
    let report := outputReport least ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg) y
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((unitGraph.imp report) ⊓ (report.imp unitGraph)))

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoveredInstallationTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundLeastTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edge4)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets (roundGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets (memberGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoveredInstallationTargets (SameLeastOnEdge)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoveredWindowTargets (coveredWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseSymmetricExchangeTargets (pairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)

def inputs {α : Type} (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings)
    (i vertices ctx ty seed out k m : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  leastGraph C X W s ctx ty seed m ⊓
    (roundGraph (edge4 X W) out i vertices ctx ty seed ⊓ memberGraph out k)

/-- Every occurrence in an actual finite round has the original seed's chosen value. -/
def ExactRoundLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings), SameLeastOnEdge C X W s →
    ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (i vertices ctx ty seed out k m : OTerm α),
      Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((inputs C X W s i vertices ctx ty seed out k m).imp
        (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty k m)))

/-- The successful output of the actual covered least program is its own successful output. -/
def ExactCoveredLeastIdempotent : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (baseX : Program 2) (baseW : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ctx ty seed m : OTerm α),
    let X := guardedExchange C s (pairedExchange baseX)
    let W := coveredWindow C s baseW
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((leastGraph C X W s ctx ty seed m).imp (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty m m)))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundLeastTargets

import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundLeastChecks
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof (programCases compositionRecover)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (programRename compositionValue projectionValue)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof (renameInto)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets (memberGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenSyntaxProof (graphRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpenSyntaxProof (leastRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverScratch (scratchVertices)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverOccurrenceTargets (occursInCover)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverOccurrenceSyntaxProof (coverIntro coverRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRetainedScanTargets (ExactRetainedPredecessor)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary)
open ID1Completion.InternalOriginalOrderSyntaxProof (ltF orderRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edge4)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeast (poolAtSeed membersAtSeed)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRounds (members membersTape poolLength)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsChecks (exact_OpenMembersAtLength)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundLeastTargets
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundLeastInductionProof (allCounts)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundLeastSyntaxProof (applyAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoveredInstallationTargets (SameLeastOnEdge)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoveredInstallationChecks (exact_CoveredEdgeValues)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedComparisonChecks (exact_SelectedInSuppliedPool)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof (tripleInputsRename quadInputsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDecodeSyntaxProof (unaryInputsRename)

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

private theorem poolArgs (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (xs : Fin 3 → OTerm α)
    (vertices : OTerm α) (hv : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (scratchVertices C s) vertices (xs 2))))
    (k : Fin 4) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph
      ((![poolAtSeed C s,.projection 0,.projection 1,.projection 2] : Fin 4 → Program 3) k)
      (membersTape vertices (xs 0) (xs 1) (xs 2) k) xs)) := by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun a => Fin.cases ?_ (fun b => Fin.cases ?_ (fun c => ?_) b) a) k
  · apply compositionValue (scratchVertices C s) (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection 2)
      vertices xs ![xs 2] hv
    intro i
    obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero i
    exact projectionValue 2 xs
  · exact projectionValue 0 xs
  · exact projectionValue 1 xs
  · obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero c
    exact projectionValue 2 xs

theorem exact_RoundLeast : ExactRoundLeast := by
  intro C X W s paid body α Γ i vertices ctx ty seed out k m
  let A := inputs C X W s i vertices ctx ty seed out k m
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := applyAt (body := body) (Delta := A :: Γ) C X W s i vertices ctx ty seed out k m
    (allCounts C X W s paid i) ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction d⟩

private theorem atLength (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings)
    (paid : SameLeastOnEdge C X W s) (ctx ty seed m vertices pool : OTerm α)
    (least : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty seed m)))
    (hit : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph pool m)))
    (computed : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (members (edge4 X W)) pool (membersTape vertices ctx ty seed)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty m m)) := by
  apply programCases poolLength ![vertices] _
  intro β j Δ fuel keep length
  rw [leastRename]
  rw [unaryInputsRename] at length
  have value := renameInto least j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename] at value
  have g := renameInto hit j Δ keep
  rw [graphRename] at g
  have ss := renameInto computed j Δ keep
  simp only [programRename,membersTape,quadInputsRename] at ss
  obtain ⟨atLen⟩ := exact_OpenMembersAtLength (edge4 X W) body β Δ (pool.relabel j) fuel
    (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j)
  obtain ⟨rule⟩ := exact_RoundLeast C X W s paid body β Δ fuel (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j)
    (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j) (pool.relabel j) (m.relabel j) (m.relabel j)
  obtain ⟨l⟩ := length
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := ss
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := g
  obtain ⟨value⟩ := value
  have run := Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.implicationElimination atLen l)) v
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationElimination rule (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction value (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction run g))⟩

private theorem fromVertices (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings)
    (paid : SameLeastOnEdge C X W s) (ctx ty seed m vertices : OTerm α)
    (least : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty seed m)))
    (physical : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (scratchVertices C s) vertices seed))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty m m)) := by
  apply programCases (members (edge4 X W)) (membersTape vertices ctx ty seed) _
  intro β j Δ pool keep computed
  rw [leastRename]
  simp only [membersTape,quadInputsRename] at computed
  have v := renameInto physical j Δ keep
  rw [NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeOpenSyntaxProof.unaryRename] at v
  have value := renameInto least j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename] at value
  let xs : Fin 3 → OTerm β := ![ctx.relabel j,ty.relabel j,seed.relabel j]
  let ys := membersTape (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j)
  obtain ⟨run⟩ := compositionValue (members (edge4 X W)) ![poolAtSeed C s,.projection 0,.projection 1,.projection 2]
    pool xs ys computed (poolArgs C s xs (vertices.relabel j) v)
  obtain ⟨selection⟩ := exact_SelectedInSuppliedPool C X W s body β Δ (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j)
    (seed.relabel j) pool (m.relabel j)
  obtain ⟨value⟩ := value
  have hit := Derivation.implicationElimination selection (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction run value)
  exact atLength C X W s paid (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j) (m.relabel j)
    (vertices.relabel j) pool ⟨value⟩ ⟨hit⟩ computed

theorem exact_CoveredLeastIdempotent : ExactCoveredLeastIdempotent := by
  intro C s baseX baseW body α Γ ctx ty seed m X W
  let A := leastGraph C X W s ctx ty seed m
  have value : Nonempty (Derivation body (A :: Γ) A) := ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  have result : Nonempty (Derivation body (A :: Γ) (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty m m)) := by
    apply programCases (scratchVertices C s) ![seed] _
    intro β j Δ vertices keep physical
    rw [leastRename]
    rw [unaryInputsRename] at physical
    have v := renameInto value j Δ keep
    simp only [A,leastRename] at v
    exact fromVertices C X W s (exact_CoveredEdgeValues C s baseX baseW) _ _ _ _ vertices v physical
  obtain ⟨result⟩ := result
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction result⟩

#print axioms exact_RoundLeast
#print axioms exact_CoveredLeastIdempotent
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundLeastChecks

open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrappedAuxProof (exact_OpenCoverCombinedWrappedAuxFormation)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperReportProof (exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredClassApplicationProof (exact_FullyMeasuredClassApplication)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)}

theorem exact_MeasuredApplicationExists : ExactMeasuredApplicationExists := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod fn arg P W Xm syn ty function argument
  have formed := exact_OpenCoverCombinedWrappedAuxFormation V TV M M0 B T s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod fn arg syn ty function argument
  obtain ⟨report⟩ := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport P.cover P.W P.V Xm s body α Γ
    ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg) formed
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight report⟩

/-- Eliminate the right application's existential least before applying the
already checked class law. No chosen witness escapes its original binder. -/
private theorem availableClassLeast
    (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    {α : Type} (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ctx dom cod f g x arg m : OTerm α) :
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s
      (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) (directedX base P.V)))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx (rawCons dom cod) f x)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx (rawCons dom cod) g x)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) m)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (hasLeast P.cover Xm W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg) m)) := by
  intro P W Xm syn ty argument lf lg af hg
  apply casesLeast P.cover Xm W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg) _ hg
  intro β j Δ m' keep ag
  rw [leastRename,auxiliaryTermRename]
  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
  rw [windowRename] at argument'
  have lf' := renameInto lf j Δ keep
  have lg' := renameInto lg j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename,rawConsRename] at lf' lg'
  have af' := renameInto af j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename,auxiliaryTermRename] at af'
  rw [auxiliaryTermRename] at ag
  exact exact_FullyMeasuredClassApplication V TV M M0 B T base s body β Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j)
    (x.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) (m.relabel j) m' syn' ty' argument' lf' lg' af' ag

theorem exact_MeasuredClassApplicationExists : ExactMeasuredClassApplicationExists := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g x arg goal P W Xm a b
    syn ty functionF functionG argument lf lg finish
  have ha := exact_MeasuredApplicationExists V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod f arg syn ty functionF argument
  have hb := exact_MeasuredApplicationExists V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ
    ctx dom cod g arg syn ty functionG argument
  apply casesLeast P.cover Xm W s ctx cod a goal ha
  intro β j Δ m keep la
  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
  rw [windowRename] at argument'
  have lf' := renameInto lf j Δ keep
  have lg' := renameInto lg j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename,rawConsRename] at lf' lg'
  have hb' := renameInto hb j Δ keep
  rw [hasRename,auxiliaryTermRename] at hb'
  have la' : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
      (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
        (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)) m)) := by
    rw [← auxiliaryTermRename]
    exact la
  have lb := availableClassLeast (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j)
    (x.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) m syn' ty' argument' lf' lg' la' hb'
  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at lb
  exact finish β j Δ m keep la lb

#print axioms exact_MeasuredApplicationExists
#print axioms exact_MeasuredClassApplicationExists
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationExistenceProof

/-- The application motive at a function-level round member `k`: `k` has the
fixed selected measure `μ` under `N`, and the application of `k` to the fixed
`arg` (annotations `dom`, `cod`) has the successful packed least `m` of the
application-level programs `C X W s` at `ctx`, `ty`. -/
def appMotive {α : Type} (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3)
    (s : Settings) (ctx ty dom cod arg μ m k : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary N μ k ⊓ leastGraph C X W s ctx ty (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg) m

/-- One-edge premise in the style of `SameLeastOnEdge`, at every body, context
and term: an accepted function-level edge `w → k` of the edge program `E` at
`fctx`, `fty` carries the application motive from `w` to `k`. -/
def ApplicationEdgeStep (E : Program 4) (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2)
    (W : Program 3) (s : Settings) : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (fctx fty ctx ty dom cod arg μ m w k : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((acceptEdge E fctx fty w k ⊓
      appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m w).imp (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m k)))

/-- The same premise relative to one context `Γ` and fixed parameters: it is
asked only in contexts that extend `Γ` along a renaming, so facts held in `Γ`
(type guards, argument window) may be used to pay it. -/
def ApplicationEdgeStepAt (E : Program 4) (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2)
    (W : Program 3) (s : Settings) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) {α : Type} (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (fctx fty ctx ty dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α) : Prop :=
  ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (w k : OTerm β),
    (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (acceptEdge E (fctx.relabel j) (fty.relabel j) w k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (appMotive N C X W s (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j)
      (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) (μ.relabel j) (m.relabel j) w)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (appMotive N C X W s (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j)
      (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) (μ.relabel j) (m.relabel j) k))

/-- Round induction with the application motive, relative premise: every member
`k` of an actual finite round (any count `i`) of the members computation for `E`
from `seed` satisfies the motive, given the motive at the seed. -/
def ExactRoundApplicationLeastAt : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Program 4) (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (i vertices fctx fty seed out k ctx ty dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α),
    ApplicationEdgeStepAt E N C X W s body Γ fctx fty ctx ty dom cod arg μ m →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m seed)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (roundGraph E out i vertices fctx fty seed)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m k))

/-- The same in the formula style of #835 `ExactRoundLeast`, under the global
one-edge premise. -/
def ExactRoundApplicationLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Program 4) (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings),
    ApplicationEdgeStep E N C X W s →
    ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
      (i vertices fctx fty seed out k ctx ty dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α),
      Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m seed ⊓
        (roundGraph E out i vertices fctx fty seed ⊓ memberGraph out k)).imp
        (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m k)))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationTargets

function-level round and the application-level least use the one measured
exchange `Xm` (same cover and window). Layout of
`ExactMeasuredCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt`, with the application exchange
`X` replaced by `Xm`. -/
def ExactFullyMeasuredApplicationEdgeStepAt : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    ApplicationEdgeStepAt (edge4 Xm W) (selectedMeasure P.R) P.cover Xm W s body Γ
      ctx (rawCons dom cod) ctx cod dom cod arg μ m

/-- Round theorem with one exchange system throughout: the round is computed
with `edge4 Xm W` and the application least is the least of `Xm`. No measure
premise. Layout of `ExactMeasuredCombinedRoundApplicationLeast`. -/
def ExactFullyMeasuredRoundApplicationLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f arg μ m i vertices out k : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) μ f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) m)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (roundGraph (edge4 Xm W) out i vertices ctx (rawCons dom cod) f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) μ k ⊓
      leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg) m))

representative, with the function's least and both application leasts taken
for the one measured exchange `Xm`. The seed's measure is not an input; the
seed application's least `m` is. Layout of
`ExactMeasuredCombinedLeastRepresentativeApplication`. -/
def ExactFullyMeasuredLeastRepresentativeApplication : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)

    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) m)) →

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

theorem inverseEq (x y : OTerm α) (e : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (equal x y))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (equal y x)) := by
  rw [equalEqn] at e ⊢
  obtain ⟨h⟩ := e
  exact ⟨symm h⟩

theorem literalAddress (c t k : OTerm α) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary addressGood (suc z) (addressTerm c t k))) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawContext c (addressTerm c t k))) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawResult t (addressTerm c t k))) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast k (addressTerm c t k))) := by
  let n := addressTerm c t k
  have code : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary addressTag (numeral 3) n)) :=
    literalGraph 3 ![n]
  have selected := packedNode addressTag (numeral 3) [c,t,k] code
  exact ⟨selected.1,selected.2.1,selected.2.2.1,selected.2.2.2.1⟩

theorem literalAtom (tag : Nat) (c t : OTerm α) (tail : List (OTerm α)) :
    let payload := rawCons (numeral tag) (packedBody (t::tail))
    let x := addressTerm c t payload
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (atomSource tag (t::tail).length) (suc z) x)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (sourceFields x c t)) := by
  dsimp only
  let payload := rawCons (numeral tag) (packedBody (t::tail))
  let x := addressTerm c t payload
  let n := (t::tail).length
  let code := literal 1 tag
  let inner := nodeGood code n
  let check := applyUnary inner rawLeast
  obtain ⟨shell,hc,ht,hk⟩ := literalAddress (body := body) (Γ := Γ) c t payload
  have literalTag : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary code (numeral tag) payload)) :=
    literalGraph tag ![payload]
  have seen := packedNode code (numeral tag) (t::tail) literalTag
  have termGood : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary check (suc z) x)) :=
    makeUnary inner rawLeast (suc z) x payload seen.1 hk
  have rawTy : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (field 0) t payload)) := seen.2.1
  have sameStored : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary storedType t x)) :=
    makeUnary (field 0) rawLeast t x payload rawTy hk
  have ok : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary storedTypeFits (suc z) x)) := by

open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering

open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)

open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)

open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedTargets (combinedPrograms)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperTargets (thinMatchingWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedXTargets (directedX)

open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedDomainTargets (hasLeast)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets (measuredExchange)

/-- The actual application has a successful least under the measured
exchange. Its function and argument are in the same actual matching window;
the two original type guards remain. No function or application least is
supplied. The function window is carrier evidence, not inferred from a bare
packed least call. -/
def ExactMeasuredApplicationExists : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s
      (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) (directedX base P.V)))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (hasLeast P.cover Xm W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg)))

/-- Equal function-level measured leasts give one common successful
application least. Both function carrier windows, the argument window and
the two type guards are retained. Neither application least is held: the
one common value is supplied under the genuine object continuation. -/
def ExactMeasuredClassApplicationExists : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))

    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s

    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx (rawCons dom cod) f x)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx (rawCons dom cod) g x)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),

      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (a.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (b.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputAddressTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveOpenTargets (addressReport)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitterObjectTargets (addressTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall (install)

/-- The original output address of an application, accepted by the installed
scalar. From two accepted installed-scalar operand addresses with their
original reports at one context, the measured least `m` of the actual
auxiliary term is obtained under the genuine object continuation, and the
literal original address `addressTerm ctx cod m` built on that same witness
carries its original physical report and is accepted by the same installed
scalar. No window, least call, fixed-point law or address report at the output
is a premise. Besides the two retained syntax/refit type guards, the result
type guard of the scalar's own type checker `tv` at `cod` is explicit: scalar
acceptance of any address reporting result type `cod` entails it, and `tv` is
an arbitrary program. -/
def ExactInstalledApplicationOutputAddress : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary tv (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)
          (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

/-- The same statement when the scalar's type checker is the syntax type guard
`TV` itself. The result type guard is then the second component of the
retained syntax guard, so only the two original type guards remain. -/
def ExactInstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputAddress : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv TV root other
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)
          (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputAddressTargets

# Paper 16: accepted original output address of an installed application

Serves the boundary in `verification/github-continuation-2026-11-22/HANDOFF.md`: "An accepted
application output address still needs the original output carrier/fixed-point reconstruction."
Extends `ExactInstalledCarrierApplicationExists` at the same `install … ` route. Supporting result;
no numbered statement is closed and no register item is promoted.

## Claimed

`ExactInstalledApplicationOutputAddress` (theorem `exact_InstalledApplicationOutputAddress`).
For the installed route `Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other`, any ID1 body, context
and terms: given the two original type guards, the two operand address reports at one context
`ctx` and installed-scalar acceptance of both operand addresses, every goal follows that follows —
under the object continuation over `(β) (j) (Δ) (m)` — from all three of

- `leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg) m`
  (`m` is the measured packed least of the actual auxiliary term),
- `addressReport (addressTerm ctx cod m) ctx cod m` (the literal original tag-3 address on that
  same witness carries its original physical report), and
- `unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm ctx cod m)` (the same installed scalar accepts it).

The address is the one the original frontend emits: `outputReport least ctx cod aux y` is
`∃k. least(ctx,cod,aux)=k ∧ y = addressTerm ctx cod k`. Its class field is the least `m`, not the
auxiliary term; an address storing `aux` is not what the frontend outputs and is not in general a
fixed point.

`ExactInstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputAddress`: the same at `tv := TV`, where only the two
original type guards remain as type premises.

What is derived rather than assumed at the output: the context check (from the function address's
coordinates), the window at the least (wrapped auxiliary formation, then the selected-window law),
the fixed point `leastGraph … m m` (covered-least idempotence #835-family, which applies because
`thinPairedExchange` / `thinMatchingWindow` are literal recuts of `pairedExchange` /
`coveredWindow`; the kernel accepted this by unfolding, no equality lemma was added), and the
report itself (`literalAddress`).

## Assumed (explicit premises)

- `unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod` and the `refitGuard s T` pair — the two original
  type guards, unchanged from the integration statement.
- General statement only: `unary tv (suc z) cod`, the scalar's own type check at the result type.
  This is not derivable (`tv` is an arbitrary program; the operands give only `tv (rawCons dom cod)`
  and `tv dom`) and it is necessary: `exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` applied to the conclusion
  returns it. It is one of the four acceptance coordinates; the other three are proved.
- Both operand reports and both operand scalar acceptances, as in the integration statement.

## Not claimed

- Acceptance by the application program itself,
  `programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf,qa,addressTerm ctx cod m]`. That needs the
  `applicationReport` block: `arrowGood qf`, `arrowReports qf dom cod`, the shell equations
  `qf = addressTerm ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn`, `qa = addressTerm ctx dom arg`, and the six-witness
  block introduction. None is assumed or used here.
- Discharge of the two type guards, callback/base calibration, `InstalledTupleAt` source semantics.
- That `tv` and `TV` coincide in the source; the second statement is the instance, not a
  calibration.
- Any closed existential formula for the output; the witness stays under the continuation.

## Evidence

Targets sha256 `7164f6998e96658f10e0a5e55b9cfbb821de9655aef7262e0254b521afaf8eca`, frozen before the
proof module existed. Receipt `build-reports/1795397242217822492-3231382.json`. Axioms: `propext`,
`Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` for both theorems. See `OUTPUT-ADDRESS-EVIDENCE.json`.
